title: Ox Passion Blue Mist Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Blue Mist is a bold and refreshing blend of juicy Blueberry and icy Menthol. The deep, sweet flavour of ripe blueberries unfolds smoothly, while a wave of cooling menthol sweeps through on the exhale, delivering a crisp and revitalising vape that lingers long after each puff. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with well-defined flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it provides rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
